```{r setup-appendix-ppc}
#| include: false
# Setup chunk for PPC diagnostics appendix
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(gt)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(rlang)

# Define project root (works whether rendering from reports/ or project root)
current_dir <- getwd()
if (basename(current_dir) == "reports") {
  proj_root <- normalizePath(file.path(current_dir, ".."), mustWork = FALSE)
} else {
  proj_root <- current_dir
}

# Define output directories
p <- file.path(proj_root, "output/publish")

# Helper function: safe read CSV (returns NULL if file doesn't exist)
sread <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}

# Helper function: fig_path (same as main chapter)
fig_path <- function(fig_name) {
  # Try multiple possible locations
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(proj_root, "output/figures", fig_name),
    file.path(proj_root, "output/publish", fig_name),
    file.path(proj_root, "figures", fig_name),
    fig_name  # Try relative path as fallback
  )
  
  for (candidate in candidates) {
    if (file.exists(candidate)) {
      return(candidate)
    }
  }
  
  # If not found, return the most likely path (let rendering handle error)
  return(file.path(proj_root, "output/figures", fig_name))
}

# Helper function: include_graphics_safe
include_graphics_safe <- function(fig_path_result) {
  # For LaTeX with root.dir set, fig_path() returns "../output/figures/..." 
  # Use error=FALSE to skip validation since we know the file exists (we checked in fig_path)
  knitr::include_graphics(fig_path_result, error = FALSE)
}

# Load PPC objects from CSV/RDS files
# These should be generated by the PPC export scripts
ppc_subj_cens <- sread(file.path(p, "table3_ppc_primary_subjectwise_censored.csv"))
has_ppc_subj_cens <- length(ppc_subj_cens) > 0
ppc_gate <- sread(file.path(p, "ppc_gate_summary.csv"))

# Load pf_subj object (may be in RDS format)
pf_subj <- NULL
pf_subj_rds <- file.path(p, "pf_subj.rds")
if (file.exists(pf_subj_rds)) {
  pf_subj <- readRDS(pf_subj_rds)
} else {
  # Try to reconstruct from CSV if available
  pf_subj_csv <- sread(file.path(p, "pf_subj_summary.csv"))
  if (!is.null(pf_subj_csv)) {
    pf_subj <- list(
      n_cells = pf_subj_csv$n_cells[1],
      n_flagged = pf_subj_csv$n_flagged[1],
      pct_flagged = pf_subj_csv$pct_flagged[1]
    )
  }
}

# Load tbl_sens from the DDM refits run directory
# This should match the RUN_ID used in the main chapter (params$run_dir)
RUN_ID <- "20260214_045745"  # Matches main chapter run_dir
RUN_DIR <- here::here("output", "ddm_refits", "runs", RUN_ID)
TABLE_DIR <- file.path(RUN_DIR, "tables")
tbl_sens <- NULL
if (file.exists(file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ddm_sensitivity_thresholds.csv"))) {
  tbl_sens <- read_csv(file.path(TABLE_DIR, "ddm_sensitivity_thresholds.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Standardize column names (same as main chapter)
  if ("loo_ic" %in% names(tbl_sens) && !"looic" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
    tbl_sens <- tbl_sens %>% rename(looic = loo_ic)
  }
  if ("loo_se" %in% names(tbl_sens) && !"looic_se" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
    tbl_sens <- tbl_sens %>% rename(looic_se = loo_se)
  }
  if ("LOOIC" %in% names(tbl_sens) && !"looic" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
    tbl_sens <- tbl_sens %>% rename(looic = LOOIC)
  }
  if (("LOOIC_SE" %in% names(tbl_sens) || "looic_SE" %in% names(tbl_sens)) && !"looic_se" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
    se_col <- if ("LOOIC_SE" %in% names(tbl_sens)) "LOOIC_SE" else "looic_SE"
    tbl_sens <- tbl_sens %>% rename(looic_se = !!sym(se_col))
  }
}
```

### A3.1 PPC Validation Method {#sec-ch3-ppc-method .unnumbered}

PPC thresholds (pre-registered): mid-body QP RMSE < 0.09 s, |Δ accuracy| < 0.05, KS < 0.15, and <15% of subject-condition cells flagged. Residuals = observed minus posterior median. Unconditional trial simulations used `RWiener` [@wabersich2014rwiener]; plots used `bayesplot` [@gabry2019bayesplot].
